title: Mit-Bestand Zwischenbericht LaTeX Workshop
description: Create mit-bestand zwischenbericht LaTeX document with placeholder content and configure LaTeX Workshop for Tectonic build.
summary: Fixed body text rendering: a dangling \ExplSyntaxOn at the end of the \AfterEndPreamble hook in semio-window.sty left expl3 space catcode 9 active after \begin{document}, silently stripping every space from section headings, chip labels, and prose (words concatenated, lines overshot margins). Added the missing \ExplSyntaxOff. Rebuilt zwischenbericht light+dark PDFs; verified pages 2/5/6/7 show normal LaTeX spacing and wrapping.
